newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zaire rebels hand over 62 children,adults--UNICEF.
newsitem.headline: Zaire rebels hand over 62 children,adults--UNICEF.

text.p: Zairean rebels have handed over 62 Rwandan refugee children and adults following a U.N. demand to know the fate of some 110 people abducted from a paediatric hospital near Bukavu, a UNICEF spokesman said on Thursday.

Patrick McCormick said the U.N. Children's Fund (UNICEF) was "crosschecking" the identity of the Rwandans against the list of those who were taken away by armed men on Saturday at Lwiro, some 30 km (20 miles) north of Bukavu in rebel-held territory.

Aid agencies said on Monday they feared some 50 malnourished Rwandan Hutu refugee children and 60 adults, mostly family members, had been killed after they were seized at Lwiro. The U.N. protested to the authorities put in place by the rebel Alliance of Democratic Forces for the Liberation of Congo-Zaire.

"UNICEF and other agency representatives were contacted by the liaison minister for the Alliance in Bukavu and invited to travel to the airport last night," McCormick told Reuters in Geneva. "There, they were met with other Alliance representatives including the regional governor.
"A total of 62 children and adults were handed over. The children were spending last night at the transit centre in Bukavu and we understand that they they will be repatriated to Rwanda."
The UNICEF spokesman said agencies were cross-checking the identities of the children, adding: "We have no results of that cross-checking yet." Their state of health was not known.
